title: A sidechained compressor listens to the same track or group in the set
description:
As a producer, I want a sidechained compressor to listen to the same track in the set, so that the kick still ducks the bass.

```gherkin
Feature: Sidechain
  Scenario: A compressor keyed from another track
    Given the track "bass" has "comp 4:1 -24dB sidechain kick"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the Compressor on "bass" has its sidechain on
    And its sidechain listens to the track "kick"

  Scenario: Keyed from a track spread over several audio tracks
    Given the track "kick" plays notes that overlap
    And the track "bass" has "comp 4:1 -24dB sidechain kick"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the Compressor on "bass" listens to the group track "kick"

  Scenario: Keyed from a group track
    Given the track "bass" has "comp 4:1 -24dB sidechain beat" where "beat" is a group
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the Compressor on "bass" listens to the group track "beat"
```
